inputs.prompt:
Cinematic action VFX shot, handheld camera. A dark modern office aisle at night: rows of desks with black monitors, warm linear ceiling light strips overhead, grey carpet. A man in a black suit and tie sits on an office chair in the foreground, turned toward camera.

[0s-0.6s] The frame holds on the seated man; deep down the aisle behind him a sudden orange fireball erupts, blowing outward between the desks and throwing papers and debris into the air. The ceiling light strips flare white, then flicker.
[0.6s-1.4s] The shockwave rushes forward, the camera shakes hard and drifts off axis, monitors topple, embers and loose sheets of paper sweep past the lens. The man stays seated and still, rim-lit orange from behind, smoke rolling over his shoulders.
[1.4s-2.3s] The fire settles into a churning glow, the camera shake eases into an unsteady handheld hold, debris drifting down through the smoke, his silhouette sharp against the burning aisle.

Handheld shake throughout, single continuous take, no cuts, no dissolves.
Audio: a low sub-bass thump on ignition, a sharp concussive blast, glass and debris scattering, crackling fire, a high ringing tone fading in after the blast, muffled room tone underneath.
